content:
Single-file examples in Verso's "Manual" genre can now be created, previewed, and shared in live.lean-lang.org. The following examples are available from the "Examples" dropdown in live.lean-lang.org:

  • Verso Math and Programming
  • Verso Proof States
  • Verso Diagrams

We hope that this will make it much easier to get started creating documents and documentation Verso, and will make it easier for existing users to explain features to new users.

There are many possible next steps we could take with this (support for other genres like slides and blueprints would obviously be desirable) and I'd welcome your feedback, bug reports, or feature requests.
